youtube.title: Douk Audio A5 vs A5 PRO: Which TPA3255 Amp? #shorts
youtube.description:
Two budget TPA3255 amps from Douk Audio: the $89.99 A5 with a high-pass filter vs the $114.99 A5 PRO with Bluetooth, tone controls and a headphone jack. Full comparison: https://wisechoicekr.com/best/douk-audio-a5-vs-a5-pro/

Prices from Douk Audio's store at the time of recording. Based on published specs and store info, not hands-on testing.

Narrated with an AI voice.

#doukaudio #tpa3255 #amplifier #hifi #audiophile

scenes.title: Douk Audio A5 or A5 PRO?
scenes.say: Two budget amps from Douk Audio. The A5 for eighty nine ninety nine, or the A5 PRO for one fourteen ninety nine.

scenes.title: Same chip, same power
scenes.say: Both use the same TPA3255 chip and the same rated power: seventy eight watts per channel with the included adapter. Both let you swap op-amps.

scenes.title: Built for a subwoofer
scenes.say: The A5 has a high-pass filter, so small speakers skip the deep bass and a subwoofer handles it. But there's no Bluetooth.

scenes.title: Bluetooth and headphones
scenes.say: The A5 PRO adds Bluetooth, bass and treble knobs, and a headphone jack. It drops the high-pass filter.

scenes.title: "300W" is the max
scenes.say: Heads up. Three hundred watts is the maximum. Expect seventy eight watts with the included adapter, or one twenty with the forty eight volt one.

scenes.title:
Subwoofer → A5
Streaming → A5‑PRO
scenes.say: Adding a subwoofer? Get the A5. Streaming from your phone or using headphones? Get the A5 PRO. Full comparison on WiseChoice K R dot com.
